items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: They called him Big Harry. He was a confidence man. And Little Harry was a confidence man.

ctx.x: So then they had Harry Merrill. They called him Big Harry. He was a confidence man. And Little Harry was a confidence man. They were -- wouldn't exactly call them pimps because they made their own money by confidencing people, you see. In fact they confidenced my stepfather out of his grocery, out of his grocery store. Yes, they did. I didn't know it was them until years after. And I found it was Harry, Big Harry and Little Harry, confidenced my stepfather.
Did they know he was your stepfather?
